## Motivation

Follow up on [the accuracy-test request in #42973](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42973#issuecomment-6436606158). Extend the existing `test_dsa_glm52_pd_kv_shard_hicache.py` with GSM8K accuracy coverage for KV sharding and CPU HiCache together.

## Modifications

- Use a single `base-c / 4-gpu-gb300` registration for the existing reload regression and both accuracy cases. All use P2/D2 with prefill CP2; decode uses GPUs 2–3. Retain the known GB300 fabric transport and exportable allocator: `MC_FORCE_MNNVL=true`, `SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL=NVLINK`, staging disabled.
- Preserve the original cold/device-hit/host-reload assertions. Reuse its request and cache-counter helpers.
- Retain the layer-split scoring settings: 1319-question cap, 20 shots, 48 evaluation threads and a **0.935** accuracy floor. The evaluator excludes the 20 demonstrations, leaving 1299 held-out questions. The 32-question Mixed-MoE smoke retains its **0.8** floor and uses target DeepEP with D-side DP2/EP2 plus a TP-only draft.
- Seed the evaluator prefix into write-through HiCache and wait for its D2H backup. Two independent 12,288-token prompts exceed CP2's 16,384 logical GPU slots while fitting in the 4× host cache. Score without flushing the host copy and require H2D growth during evaluation.
- Bound the accuracy fixture's context length to 16,384, decode pool to 65,536 tokens and ordinary decode concurrency/graph size to 48; Mixed-MoE retains an eight-request limit. Disable decode prefix reuse and check decode-side MTP activity.
- Add the standalone [KV sharing guide](https://github.com/HZY-Wade/sglang/blob/codex/glm-sharded-hicache-accuracy/docs/docs/advanced_features/kv_cache_sharing.mdx), its navigation entry and updated argument reference. Remove only the duplicated GLM KV sharing section from the P/D overview. The guide distinguishes its deployment recipe from the four-GPU CI fixtures.

## Accuracy Tests

Local validation using the project `.venv`:

- Exactly one CI registration and three active tests with four visible GPUs; hardware tests skip when fewer than four are available.
- All six P/D launch configurations parse, including DP2/EP2 for Mixed-MoE; both sides retain the GB300 transport environment.
- The original reload test body and both accuracy floors remain unchanged.
- Eight mocked control-flow cases pass: success and expected failures for missing H2D reload, insufficient accuracy and missing MTP activity, for both accuracy cases.
- Applicable pre-commit checks and documentation build/link validation pass.

On head `e19de3aef0`, the [four-GB300 hardware job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40650131890/job/122688169704) passed the reload regression and the full GSM8K test, scoring **0.9438029253271748 >= 0.935**, including its H2D and MTP assertions. Mixed-MoE failed during decode setup: target + draft weights required a static-memory fraction above approximately 0.870, exceeding the inherited 0.85 budget. This change overrides **only Mixed-MoE decode to 0.90**, retaining the 65,536-token KV cap and accuracy floors; parser checks and pre-commit pass. **The corrected Mixed-MoE case still needs hardware verification.** The CI time estimate remains 600 seconds.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Test and documentation changes only; no inference runtime changes or performance claims.

## Checklist

- [x] Format and pre-commit checks.
- [x] Extend the existing E2E file and validate registration, topology and control flow.
- [x] Update the standalone guide and test-source reference.
- [ ] Run the added accuracy cases on the four-GB300 CI runner.

@@ -0,0 +1,197 @@
+---
+title: "KV Cache Sharing"
+metatags:
+    description: "Page-based KV cache sharding for prefill context parallelism, CPU HiCache, and P/D serving."
+---
+
+KV cache sharing reduces duplicate KV storage across GPUs in a prefill worker. It keeps one persistent copy of each cache page within the shard group, allowing the same GPU memory budget to retain more unique tokens.
+
+[Prefill context parallelism (CP)](/docs/advanced_features/prefill_cp) distributes prompt computation, but can still leave the cached history replicated across ranks. KV cache sharing distributes those stored pages as well. This is useful for long-context and multi-turn workloads that reuse large prefixes.
+
+## How it works
+
+### Shared logical tree, distributed pages
+
+Every rank keeps the same logical radix tree and request-to-token mapping. A prefix match therefore identifies the same cached tokens on all ranks, while each GPU stores only the pages it owns.
+
+For example, a CP4 group can distribute eight logical pages as follows:
+
+| Rank | Stored pages |
+| --- | --- |
+| 0 | A, E |
+| 1 | B, F |
+| 2 | C, G |
+| 3 | D, H |
+
+A request that reuses A–D matches the same logical prefix on every rank. New pages continue the cached path's ownership sequence, and prefixes remain reusable at the original page size.
+
+### Gather one layer at a time
+
+Before attention reads a cached prefix, each rank contributes its owned pages to an all-gather. Attention reads the assembled prefix from a temporary layer buffer, using a page-table mapping to preserve the logical token order.
+
+Two buffers alternate across layers so the next gather can overlap with current-layer computation. Their memory is included in the cache budget. A prefix hit saves recomputation, but still incurs the cost of gathering the distributed KV.
+
+### HiCache and MTP integration
+
+[HiCache](/docs/advanced_features/hicache) preserves page ownership during GPU-to-host backup and host-to-GPU reload. Each rank backs up and restores its own pages. For each layer, execution follows this order:
+
+```text Read order
+Restore local pages → Gather the prefix → Run attention
+```
+
+With GLM MTP, the target and draft KV/indexer state follow the same ownership plan and are restored together. During [P/D transfer](/docs/advanced_features/pd_disaggregation), each prefill rank sends the pages it owns; decode receives complete, unsharded cache entries.
+
+## Usage example
+
+Enable KV cache sharing with `--enable-kv-cache-sharding` on the prefill worker only.
+
+The following example uses Linux with NVIDIA CUDA on two GB300 nodes, with four GPUs per worker. Prefill uses TP4/CP4 and CPU HiCache; decode uses TP4/EP4 with attention DP4. Both workers use the same GLM-5.3 NVFP4 checkpoint and model revision.
+
+### Environment variables
+
+Create `kv-shard.env` on both nodes. Replace the example IP addresses and RDMA NIC names with values for your environment. This example uses Mooncake RDMA for P/D transfer.
+
+```bash Environment variables
+cat > kv-shard.env <<'EOF'
+export MODEL_PATH=RadixArk/GLM-5.3-NVFP4
+export MODEL_REVISION=6e389189d564d9d3e4ea7fa284fe91f136d8ae2a
+export PREFILL_HOST=192.0.2.10
+export DECODE_HOST=192.0.2.20
+export PREFILL_IB_DEVICES=mlx5_0,mlx5_1,mlx5_2,mlx5_3
+export DECODE_IB_DEVICES=mlx5_0,mlx5_1,mlx5_2,mlx5_3
+export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
+export SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER=0
+export MC_TCP_ENABLE_CONNECTION_POOL=true
+unset MC_FORCE_MNNVL SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL
+EOF
+```
+
+### Prefill worker: TP4/CP4
+
+Run this command on the prefill node. It enables interleave CP, page-based KV sharding, CPU HiCache, and EAGLE MTP.
+
+```bash Prefill worker
+source ./kv-shard.env
+export SGLANG_UNIFIED_RADIX_TREE_CORE_BACKEND=python
+python -m sglang.launch_server \
+  --model-path "$MODEL_PATH" \
+  --revision "$MODEL_REVISION" \
+  --served-model-name glm-kv-shard \
+  --trust-remote-code \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 \
+  --port 30001 \
+  --disaggregation-mode prefill \
+  --disaggregation-transfer-backend mooncake \
+  --disaggregation-bootstrap-port 30200 \
+  --disaggregation-ib-device "$PREFILL_IB_DEVICES" \
+  --nccl-port 29501 \
+  --tp 4 \
+  --base-gpu-id 0 \
+  --enable-prefill-cp \
+  --attn-cp-size 4 \
+  --cp-strategy interleave \
+  --enable-kv-cache-sharding \
+  --dsa-prefill-backend trtllm \
+  --dsa-decode-backend trtllm \
+  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
+  --page-size 64 \
+  --mem-fraction-static 0.9 \
+  --chunked-prefill-size 16384 \
+  --max-running-requests 32 \
+  --enable-hierarchical-cache \
+  --hicache-size 240 \
+  --hicache-host-memory-mode cache \
+  --hicache-write-policy write_through \
+  --hicache-io-backend kernel \
+  --hicache-mem-layout page_first \
+  --bf16-gemm-backend cutedsl \
+  --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_cutlass \
+  --disable-shared-experts-fusion \
+  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE \
+  --speculative-num-steps 3 \
+  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
+  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 \
+  --enable-metrics \
+  --enable-metrics-for-all-schedulers \
+  --enable-cache-report
+```
+
+### Decode worker: TP4/EP4
+
+Run this command on the decode node. The target uses attention DP4 and FlashInfer A2A with EP4; the EAGLE draft uses the TP-only path. Decode does not enable KV cache sharding.
+
+```bash Decode worker
+source ./kv-shard.env
+python -m sglang.launch_server \
+  --model-path "$MODEL_PATH" \
+  --revision "$MODEL_REVISION" \
+  --served-model-name glm-kv-shard \
+  --trust-remote-code \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 \
+  --port 30003 \
+  --disaggregation-mode decode \
+  --disaggregation-transfer-backend mooncake \
+  --disaggregation-bootstrap-port 30200 \
+  --disaggregation-ib-device "$DECODE_IB_DEVICES" \
+  --nccl-port 31000 \
+  --tp 4 \
+  --base-gpu-id 0 \
+  --attn-dp-size 4 \
+  --ep-size 4 \
+  --enable-dp-lm-head \
+  --enable-dp-attention-local-control-broadcast \
+  --dsa-prefill-backend trtllm \
+  --dsa-decode-backend trtllm \
+  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
+  --page-size 64 \
+  --mem-fraction-static 0.9 \
+  --max-running-requests 512 \
+  --disable-radix-cache \
+  --bf16-gemm-backend cutedsl \
+  --moe-a2a-backend flashinfer \
+  --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm_routed \
+  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE \
+  --speculative-num-steps 3 \
+  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
+  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 \
+  --speculative-moe-a2a-backend none \
+  --speculative-moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm \
+  --enable-metrics \
+  --enable-metrics-for-all-schedulers \
+  --enable-cache-report
+```
+
+### Router
+
+After both workers are healthy, start the router on a host that can reach them. The worker HTTP endpoints, prefill bootstrap port, and RDMA transport must be reachable between nodes.
+
+```bash Router
+source ./kv-shard.env
+curl --fail "http://${PREFILL_HOST}:30001/health"
+curl --fail "http://${DECODE_HOST}:30003/health"
+
+python -m sglang_router.launch_router \
+  --pd-disaggregation \
+  --prefill "http://${PREFILL_HOST}:30001" 30200 \
+  --decode "http://${DECODE_HOST}:30003" \
+  --policy cache_aware \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 \
+  --port 30000
+```
+
+### Send a request
+
+From the router host, send a request using the shared served model name:
+
+```bash Request
+curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1/chat/completions \
+  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+  -d '{"model":"glm-kv-shard","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is 17 + 25?"}],"temperature":0,"max_tokens":128}'
+```
+
+## Related documentation
+
+- [Prefill context parallelism](/docs/advanced_features/prefill_cp)
+- [HiCache design](/docs/advanced_features/hicache_design)
+- [P/D disaggregation](/docs/advanced_features/pd_disaggregation)
+- [GLM-5.3 cookbook](/cookbook/autoregressive/GLM/GLM-5.3)

+    def test_gsm8k(self):

+        # drop the host copy and turn this into a cold-cache accuracy test.
+        for url in (self.prefill_url, self.decode_url):
+            response = requests.get(url + "/flush_cache", timeout=30)
+            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+
+        data_path = download_and_cache_file(GSM8K_URL)
+        few_shot_prefix = get_few_shot_examples(
+            list(read_jsonl(data_path)), self.gsm8k_num_shots
+        )
+        backup_counter = "sglang:hicache_backup_tokens_total"
+        backups_before = self._counter(backup_counter)
+        seeded = self._generate(text=few_shot_prefix, max_tokens=1)
+        prefix_tokens = seeded["meta_info"]["prompt_tokens"]
+        cached_prefix = (prefix_tokens - 1) // PAGE_SIZE * PAGE_SIZE
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(cached_prefix, ACCURACY_CP_SIZE * PAGE_SIZE)
+        self.assertLess(prefix_tokens, ACCURACY_PREFILL_POOL_TOKENS * ACCURACY_CP_SIZE)
+        self._wait_for_counter(backup_counter, backups_before + cached_prefix)
+
+        # Independent prefixes exceed the *logical*, not per-rank, GPU pool.
+        # They and the seeded prefix fit in host memory, retaining its L2 copy.

+            self._generate(input_ids=pressure, max_tokens=1)
+
+        load_counter = "sglang:load_back_tokens_total"

+        # Call the same evaluator used by GSM8KMixin without its initial flush.

+            api="completion",
+            max_tokens=512,
+            num_shots=self.gsm8k_num_shots,
+            gsm8k_data_path=data_path,
+        )

+
+        # The router does not expose decode's MTP statistics.

+                self.assertGreater(state["avg_spec_accept_length"], 0)
